prompt:
A desktop web app screen, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser window, device or desk around it. Product: Hive, a team workspace where people chat in channels and one shared AI agent does tasks on its own computer. The visitor's job: see what the agent is doing, answer it, and review finished work before it goes out. Workspace: Fern & Fig (a plant shop). Channel list: launch, design, ops, hiring, plus Chat, Tasks, Files, Goals, Computer. Top bar: Hive bee mark with workspace name, a badge '2 need you', search, avatar.
The screen is a review of the agent's finished work: 'Write the launch email' opened beside the #launch chat. A wide white draft sheet in a text serif shows the email (subject 'The ferns are in', two short paragraphs about twelve new plants and pre-orders opening Friday). In the margin, three numbered proofreader's notes: a caret insert, a struck word, a circled sentence, each with a one-line comment from Dana. A side column lists what the agent did: 4 steps, 'checked brand voice notes', 'attached 5 photos'. Buttons: Mark done, Send back with notes (3). Review-led: the draft and its margin notes dominate.
Look: a newspaper copy desk. Deep ink-blue shell and rail, white galley sheet, proof-mark red for edits, blue-pencil blue for approvals, grotesque UI type with a sturdy text serif only inside the draft. Signature: proofreader's marks in the margin as the way to send notes back. Standard buttons and inputs.
